description: List every country one eSIM plan works in, plus any country of its own region that it leaves out. Use it to answer "does this plan also cover Austria?" for a regional or worldwide plan, where the plan name says a region and the traveller needs the actual list. For a single-country plan the answer is that one country. Ask get-plan instead for the data allowance, validity or price. Read-only.

plan_id.description: The plan id: a 26-character ULID as returned by list-plans or plan-trip, e.g. "01JVQ2S6D4X8N0RMB7YQZ5K3TA". Slugs and supplier codes are not accepted, and an id must never be invented.

name: get-plan-coverage

countries.description: Every country the plan works in. Match on iso2 to answer "does this cover X?".

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or null for a country we could not match to a code.

coverage_type.description: Scope of the plan: one country, a region, or worldwide.

excluded_countries.description: Countries in the plan's own region that it does not cover. Always empty for a country plan and for a worldwide one.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or null for a country we could not match to a code.

is_worldwide.description: True when the plan is sold as a worldwide bundle.

region_label.description: The plan's region written for a person, e.g. "Europe". Null for a country plan.

total.description: How many countries the plan covers.

total_excluded.description: How many countries of the plan's own region it does NOT cover.

title: Get plan country coverage
